name: DS Cluster D04: Crypto Pairs (24/7 Market Data)
description: Tests: crypto_pairs free-text ticker, BTC/ETH ratio, crypto returns, 24/7 trading (no session boundaries).
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER D04: Crypto Pairs
# =============================================================================
# crypto_pairs(ticker=...) loads any crypto pair by string.
# Crypto trades 24/7 — session-based transforms don't apply.

src = study_assets()
close = src.c

# === FREE-TEXT CRYPTO PAIRS ===
btc = crypto_pairs(ticker="BTCUSD")()
btc_close = btc.c
btc_vol = btc.v

eth = crypto_pairs(ticker="ETHUSD")()
eth_close = eth.c

# === BTC/ETH RATIO (dominance proxy) ===
btc_eth_ratio = btc_close / eth_close
ratio_ma = ma(period=20, type=MAType.sma)(btc_eth_ratio)

# === CRYPTO RETURNS ===
btc_ret = returns(btc_close)
eth_ret = returns(eth_close)

# === CUMULATIVE RETURN COMPARISON ===
btc_cum = cumulative()(btc_ret)
eth_cum = cumulative()(eth_ret)

# === BTC VOLATILITY (20-period rolling std of returns) ===
btc_vol_20 = agg(btc_ret, 20, AggregationType.Std)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title="BTC vs ETH (Close Price)",
    category="Crypto",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="BTC", color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="ETH", color=Color.Cyan)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(btc_close, eth_close))

xy_lines(
    title="BTC/ETH Ratio with 20d MA",
    category="Crypto",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Ratio", color=Color.Yellow),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="20d MA", color=Color.White)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(btc_eth_ratio, ratio_ma))

xy_lines(
    title="Cumulative Returns: BTC vs ETH",
    category="Crypto",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="BTC", color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="ETH", color=Color.Cyan)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[ReferenceLine(value=0, title="Flat")])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(btc_cum, eth_cum))

xy_lines(
    title="BTC Realized Volatility (20d)",
    category="Crypto",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Vol", color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=btc_vol_20)
